02. The Practice

Software, websites and business tools. The sample allocation below demonstrates the original portfolio chart; it is not measured business data.

Service mix / illustrative

SD's operations are divided among three primary pillars. The documentation formats (invoices, proposals) must be flexible enough to accommodate the distinct billing structures and project milestones of each division.

  • ■

    Software Development (45%)

    Complex, milestone-based projects requiring detailed technical proposals.

  • ■

    Web Development (35%)

    Agile sprints and retainer-based billing requiring clear, frequent invoicing.

  • ■

    Business Consulting (20%)

    Hourly tracking and strategic agreements needing strict legal formatting.

03. Document Studio
